kjv: and would have judged according to our law. But the chief captain Lysias came [upon us] ... Commanding his accusers to come unto thee
note: 24:6b–8a is absent from P74, Sinaiticus, A, B, H, L, P; a Western expansion. Without it, "by examining him" in 24:8 refers to Paul, not Lysias.
enkrateia is self-mastery in general (especially sexual, apt for Felix and Drusilla); "temperance" now suggests abstinence from alcohol.
